{{Quote|I'm most-wanted in three systems. If they find me alive, they're only going to make me wish I was dead anyway.|Jalan|<ref name="CoD" />}}
'''Jalan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and associate of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]]. He went with Cohl to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]], on a mission for the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], to steal a shipment of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] ingots from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Revenue]]''. Though the mission was successful, and the crew escaped through an arm pod, Jalan was hopelessly caught underneath a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] console when the pod they were in was shot down. Most other members of the crew had [[Death/Legends|died]]. Jalan chose to accept his fate, and died taking down some members of the [[Dorvalla Space Corps]] by self-destructing what remained of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="CoD" />
